named_method: Transparent geospatial levelized-cost model for African green hydrogen delivered to Europe via ammonia shipping and reconversion
definition: Use site-level geographic/resource inputs to estimate production and delivery costs.
Separate production cost, infrastructure cost, ammonia conversion, shipping, and reconversion components.
Represent financing explicitly through scenario-specific cost of capital and capital recovery.
Compare delivered African hydrogen cost against a European green-hydrogen production benchmark.
assumptions_to_check: Per-site renewable potential enters electricity-cost estimation.
Distances to grid, road, ocean, and water enter transparent adder terms.
Ammonia shipping and reconversion are explicitly represented as delivery-chain cost components.
At least one de-risking scenario and one interest-rate stress scenario are included.
At least one geospatial output and one competitiveness output are exported.
non_negotiable_steps: Compute scenario-specific capital recovery factor from WACC and lifetime.
Compute site-wise electricity cost and hydrogen production cost.
Add ammonia-chain delivery costs to obtain delivered cost in Europe.
Benchmark against Europe and summarize competitive-site shares.

status.notes: Implemented transparent site-wise production plus ammonia-chain delivery with financing scenarios and Europe benchmark, but used simplified capacity-factor mapping and fixed ammonia-chain adders due available data.
